name: 4FG Monitor
subtitle: Order gas. Track delivery.
promotionalText: Order cooking gas, medical oxygen and more from approved vendors near you, pay securely and follow your delivery from confirmation to your door.
description:
4FG Monitor is the easy way to get gas delivered in Nigeria. Find approved gas vendors, order the size you need, pay securely in the app and follow your delivery until it reaches your door.

FOR CUSTOMERS
• Browse approved vendors and see each vendor's price per kg, cylinder sizes and location
• Choose cooking gas, medical gas, industrial or bulk supply
• Buy a full cylinder, or buy loose gas by weight or by the amount you want to spend, where the vendor offers it
• Pay securely by card or bank transfer
• Follow every order: confirmed, out for delivery, delivered, with your rider's name and phone number
• Save your delivery addresses so reordering takes seconds
• See your spending and order history
• Get messages from 4FG about your orders and account

FOR VENDORS
• Create your business profile with your logo and CAC RC number
• List your gas products, sizes and prices, and mark items in or out of stock
• Run one location or many, with a manager for each branch
• Receive orders, update their status and assign a delivery rider
• See your earnings and receive payouts to your bank account

FOR RIDERS AND LOGISTICS COMPANIES
• Riders see the orders assigned to them, with pickup and drop-off details, and tap to call or open directions
• Update each delivery as you go, and see what you have earned
• Logistics companies invite their riders and keep an eye on every delivery

SAFE AND TRANSPARENT
• Vendors are reviewed and approved before they can sell
• You always see the price and delivery fee before you pay
• Delete your account and personal details from inside the app at any time

Questions or feedback? Contact us at https://4fgmonitor.com/contact
whatsNew: Clearer update messages, easier logo updates for vendors and a new Earnings screen for riders and vendors.
